# External dependencies of the workspace. scripts/deps installs each line.
# The GitHub CLI lists the org projects and clones each absent project.
runtime bin gh https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/v2.97.0/gh_2.97.0_{os}_{arch}.tar.gz gh_2.97.0_{os}_{arch}/bin/gh
# The secret gate of make check runs gitleaks. The release assets name the
# x86_64 architecture "x64", and the arch placeholder gives "amd64" today. The
# alias table of the org pack resolves the word, and then this line takes the
# placeholder (WS-DEPS-6).
runtime bin gitleaks https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v8.30.1/gitleaks_8.30.1_{os}_x64.tar.gz gitleaks
